query: Integrate a spectral-gating noise reduction pass before the audio separation step, then route the cleaned audio into both the vocal removal and the separation branches.

assessment.expected_no_candidate_reason: The retained spectral-gating request is a structural-feature absence: no authorable member of this workflow exposes spectral-gating control. The frozen authoritative schema gives KSampler only cfg/denoise/latent_image/model/negative/positive/sampler_name/scheduler/seed/steps, VAEEncodeAudio only audio/vae, and VAEDecodeAudio only samples/vae - there is no gate or threshold input anywhere on the audio chain, and the pack's FrequencyFilterPreset presets (remove_rumble/remove_hiss) are not spectral gating. The typed evidence mode is a structural_feature_absent blocker replayed check-by-check against the source graph and the authoritative index; a generic no_changes label is never evidence.

_tags.author_rationale: The query demands integrating a spectral-gating noise reduction pass, but no authorable member of the retained workflow exposes that feature: the frozen schema attests KSampler/VAEEncodeAudio/VAEDecodeAudio carry no gate control, and the pack's available filter presets are limited to rumble/hiss removal. The designation is expected-no-candidate under a typed structural-feature contract adjudicated by replaying each declared check against the source graph and the authoritative index; task_type is corrected from the historical text_to_image to match the actual all-audio outputs.
